task.title: P6-020: Prevent All-cards table overflow from long collection or card names
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Visual and layout). Original id: P6-020. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The All-cards table's 390 px fit is data-dependent and only the current seed is pinned.** No cell carries `whitespace-nowrap` anywhere in `all_cards.rs` or `collection.rs`, so min-content width is driven by the longest **unbreakable token** — and the WHERE column renders `"{n} in {collection_name}"` (`all_cards.rs:485`) with a *user-chosen* name. One space-free collection name (or a long single-word card name) re-exceeds the 356 px wrapper and reintroduces the sideways scroll that assertion was written to catch.
